title: ampelocissus bombycina
intro: Ampelocissus bombycina, commonly known as the Indian grapevine, is a plant species native to India and Southeast Asia. It is a deciduous climber with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Ampelocissus bombycina include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing fever, relieving pain, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an antipyretic, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory agent, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
